title: Frappe ERPNext 5.0.0 before 15.121.4 and 16.x before 16.36.0 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability in a…
description: Frappe ERPNext versions 5.0.0 before 15.121.4 and 16.x before 16.36.0 have an authorization vulnerability in the Selling module. The flaw allows authenticated users with restricted User Permissions to close or reopen Sales Orders belonging to other companies by exploiting insufficient permission checks on individual Sales Orders. The vulnerability does not affect confidentiality or availability but can lead to unauthorized modification of Sales Order status.
